ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) field with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels estimated at 0.05:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmented surface across approximately 95% of visible area; high-contrast white contiguous blobs concentrated at distal lobe tips; sparse, isolated white circular pixels distributed across central lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 70 degrees and a depth of approximately 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile with distinct peaks and valleys; highest amplitude peaks located on the proximal third of the trailing edge adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep trajectory from the central notch toward the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete circular high-contrast pixel clusters (diameter 5-15 pixels) scattered across the mid-ventral surface; dense, overlapping clusters at the extreme lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, high-intensity, textured clusters of surface-attached nodes localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple faint circular ring markers appearing as thin, high-intensity boundaries on the primary dark field.
